title: Exploit Attempts for GPUStack Authentication Bypass (CVE-2026-102895), (Thu, Nov 12th)
content_md: CVE-2026-102895 is a trivial authentication-bypass vulnerability. GPUStack is also an attractive target. It is open-source software that manages clusters of GPUs, which are typically used to run AI workloads. All versions of GPUStack prior to 2.2.0, which was released at the end of June. This vulnerability was not made public until the end of July, and the CVE was assigned on November 4th. Article Link: Exploit Attempts for GPUStack Authentication Bypass (CVE-2026-102895)

CVE-2026-102895.evidence: Internet-wide exploit attempts observed against internet-exposed GPUStack management instances; the bypass is trivial and all versions are affected.
